methodologyNotes: Specs sourced from official manufacturer pages (Apple support/specs, Dell product pages, Microsoft/Surface, Razer, Framework), Wikipedia articles (MacBook Air/Pro Apple silicon, ThinkPad X1 Carbon, Dell XPS 13, HP Spectre, Asus ZenBook, Surface Laptop, Framework Laptop), and verified via Newegg retailer listings. Apple moved from M4 to M5 in MacBook Air (March 2026) and MacBook Pro (October 2025); M5 models are current. Numbers stored unit-free; units implied by key name (display_in = diagonal inches, ram_gb = GB, storage_gb = base config GB, weight_kg = kg, battery_wh = Wh). storage_gb and ram_gb reflect base/reference configuration. priceUsd = US MSRP at launch for base/reference config. A null beats any guess. All sources accessed 2026-06-15.
